notes: Authoritative record spec for the Altmer race (Phase 2, OFFER / active-patron gate). Modelled structurally on PDV_KhajiitRewardRecords.spec.json. Altmer is an OFFER race: rewards gate on IsFirstTierRaceRewardEligible (active patron tier >= Seeker). Broad worship is the Orthodox STATE (R1), NOT a deity record. Altmer OWNS Magnus and Xarxes (create:true); REUSES Auri-El (create:false). Trinimac is owned by Orc and is orthodoxy PRESSURE via stance, not a reward patron here (R5/R6). Daedric forks route through the existing 20C Daedric system (R6). ThalmorAlignment is pressure/access, NOT a third boon track (R8). T3 recognition is V1 Survey/status text only (non-voiced), per PDV_RecognitionDialogueScalePacket.md.

gate.rule: Active patron tier >= Seeker (Seeker 25 / Devoted 50 / Champion 85). The first-tier race reward (broad Orthodox T1) syncs through ProcessDawn()/RunDawnApplySpellAndNeglectLayers() only when the Orthodox patron state is active and the active deity is at least Seeker.
gate.broadLaneIsState: R1: Orthodox is PATRON_STATE_BROAD resolved by GetFirstTierRaceRewardSpellForOrigin(); there is NO PDV_Deity_Orthodox / PDV_Deity_Nine record.

shared: existing record 03DE88; Altmer adds/confirms Stance_Altmer NATIVE via --reconcile-shared-deity

owned by Orc spec (create:true). Altmer reuses with Stance_Altmer added as orthodoxy PRESSURE only (R5). NOT a reward patron and NOT a 3-tier set in this spec. Listed only to confirm the shared-deity stance reconciliation; if the Orc spec has not run, Altmer authoring must skip Trinimac reconciliation rather than create the record.

faucet.model: active-patron (Altmer is one of the three faucet races). Authentic repeatable acts award real piety to Auri-El or the active secondary focus through AwardCuratedSignal/ScoreCuratedSignal, feeding the offer/tier spine so decay/neglect/creed-loss stay honest.

pace.signalsPerDay: 1-2 authentic acts per ordinary day (dawn practice + one study/magic milestone or coherent act).
pace.daysToTier: ~6 days to Seeker (25), ~12 days to Devoted (50) at the stated cadence without perfect play - meets the ledger reward-floor: ordinary Altmer life trends net-positive.
pace.note: Lorkhan/crisis PRESSURE is a separate authored-signal pressure, NOT a piety faucet. Ordinary life stays net-positive; rejected ordinary surfaces stay silent (no hidden theological debt).

v1RecognitionSurface: Champion Survey/status text only (non-voiced). GetAltmerSummary explains Auri-El foundation, current standing, crisis state, Lorkhan pressure, ThalmorAlignment band, most recent orthodox/dawn favor, and curse posture in fiction-facing terms. Voiced NPC recognition is V2 per PDV_RecognitionDialogueScalePacket.md.
budget: Two always-on boon families (R8 cap): (1) Auri-El foundation [broad Orthodox state reward + Auri-El focus], (2) ONE secondary focus (Magnus OR Xarxes, one active at a time) plus one active contextual favor family. ThalmorAlignment is pressure/access/interpretation, NOT a third boon track. Lorkhan/crisis is pressure, not a boon. Reward ceiling per ledger = Auri-El foundation + one secondary + one contextual favor family.

balanceInvariants.boonFamilyCap: 2 (Auri-El foundation + one secondary focus). ThalmorAlignment and crisis are NOT counted boon families.
balanceInvariants.broadLessThanFocused: Broad Orthodox caps at T2/Faithful and is suppressed when a patron is focused; focused 3-tier sets reach Champion.
balanceInvariants.oneAntiFarmPerAct: Each faucet act uses exactly ScoreRepeatableAction OR ConsumeDailyRepeatMultiplier, never both. Active-patron piety acts use ScoreRepeatableAction only.
balanceInvariants.asciiOnly: All playerFacingText is ASCII-only (Auri-El written with hyphen-minus).
balanceInvariants.actorValuesValid: MagickaRateMult, ResistMagic, Alteration, Restoration are valid Skyrim ActorValue names.
balanceInvariants.deityIndex: Magnus/Xarxes use next-available (serial author-time assignment, collision-free); Auri-El reuses its existing index; reused deities create:false.
balanceInvariants.oneActiveFavorFamily: Only one contextual favor family is loud at a time (costing-manifest rule).

rulingCompliance.R1: Broad Orthodox is a STATE (PATRON_STATE_BROAD), not a deity. No PDV_Deity_Orthodox/Nine record created.
rulingCompliance.R2: Broad T1 editorId is the FIXED manager property PDV_Bless_Altmer_Orthodox_T1; broad T2 = PDV_Bless_Altmer_Orthodox_T2 (same stem).
rulingCompliance.R3: Focused sets named PDV_Bless_Altmer_<Patron>_T1/T2/T3 for AuriEl/Magnus/Xarxes; grant logic mirrors SyncKhajiitEmphasisRewards (one active focus; T1>=Seeker, T2>=Devoted, T3>=Champion).
rulingCompliance.R4: Auri-El is a SHARED record; Altmer references create:false and adds Stance_Altmer via --reconcile-shared-deity. Trinimac shared from Orc owner (create:false, PRESSURE stance only).
rulingCompliance.R5: Only focusable patrons (Auri-El, Magnus, Xarxes) get/keep deity records. Trinimac is orthodoxy pressure, not a focusable reward patron here.
rulingCompliance.R6: Daedric forks route through the existing 20C Daedric system; no new Daedric Prince records authored.
rulingCompliance.R7: Altmer is offer / active-patron: rewards gate on IsFirstTierRaceRewardEligible (patron tier >= Seeker).
rulingCompliance.R8: <=2 boon families; broad<focused; one anti-farm per act; magnitude ceiling ~12%; creed-loss medium/major only; ASCII-only text; Skyrim ActorValue names only; ThalmorAlignment is not a third boon track.
